verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-configurable automation feature that runs autonomously in the background. Built-in behaviors like auto-generated scheduled payrolls and automatic tax filing are fixed product functions, not user-defined automations. Webhooks and the API are developer building blocks. The agent-friendly CLI deliberately keeps a human in the loop: writes are blocked until a --confirm re-run, and it can only draft payroll, never run it, so it does not deliver autonomous background automation.
